domain: release engineering for a heterogeneous-host plugin fleet (adjacent tier)
axioms: A user who installed last month must end up with a coherent, upgradeable system today
Version truth must live in exactly one place per artifact; every extra copy can disagree
Silent mixed-version state is a higher-severity class than a missing feature
Every binary invoked by markdown workflows needs a freshness gate or version handshake
Backup-first mutation is only safe if restore is actually possible
An unwired verifier is equivalent to no verifier
failure_mode: Read-only probe: could not run installers or doctors, so runtime behavior of install paths is inferred, not observed
Did not inspect the interagency-marketplace repo itself or Sylveste/install.sh (a fourth install path)
Did not verify whether ic publish enforces changelog entries for other plugins
Treats every declared-vs-actual version disagreement as drift even where a lag is intentional
